gloss: land sold in lots; subdivided land

definitions.gloss: land sold in lots; subdivided land for sale
definitions.explanation: A tract of land that has been divided into individual lots and sold to buyers, typically for building houses. A key concept in Japanese residential real estate.

examples.japanese: {分譲地|ぶんじょうち}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for subdivided land for sale.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}から{近|ちか}い{分譲地|ぶんじょうち}は{人気|にんき}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Subdivided lots near the station are popular.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{分譲地|ぶんじょうち}が{開発|かいはつ}され、{住宅|じゅうたく}が{次々|つぎつぎ}と{建|た}てられている。
examples.english: New subdivided lots have been developed, and houses are being built one after another.

notes:
USAGE:
A real estate term commonly seen in advertisements and housing discussions. {分譲|ぶんじょう} means "selling in lots" and appears in compounds like {分譲|ぶんじょう}マンション (condominium for sale) and {分譲|ぶんじょう}{住宅|じゅうたく} (house built on subdivided land).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分譲地|ぶんじょうち}を{買|か}う (to buy a lot)
- {分譲地|ぶんじょうち}を{探|さが}す (to look for lots)
- {分譲地|ぶんじょうち}の{開発|かいはつ} (development of subdivided land)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {宅地|たくち}: residential land — a broader term for any land designated for housing
- {分譲|ぶんじょう}マンション: condominium for sale — an apartment unit sold rather than rented
